class.name: Location
class.description: [Location] wraps OpenCASCADE's [code]TopLoc_Location[/code]. It currently supports translation and intrinsic XYZ Euler rotation in degrees, which is enough for the current [Axis] constructor pathways.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a location from [param position] and intrinsic XYZ Euler angles in degrees.

members.member: The intrinsic XYZ Euler rotation in degrees.
